exposure: Changes in systolic, diastolic, and mean arterial blood pressure after positional shift from supine to lateral and sitting positions
outcome: Occurrence of hypotension during cesarean delivery
Correlation of positional changes in hemodynamic parameters with hypotension
cohort: 100 ASA grade I parturient women undergoing cesarean section.
finding: Age, parity, and changes in heart rate, diastolic blood pressure, and mean arterial blood pressure from supine to lateral and sitting positions were significantly correlated with hypotension after spinal anesthesia during cesarean delivery.
